description: This file contains an extension of the NodeAppModel class providing static methods to normalize and process watch notification parameters, actions, risk, and priority levels within a watch notification context.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes the parameters for a watch notification, trimming strings and adjusting values based on risk and priority.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Normalizes an array of watch actions, trimming whitespace and limiting the number of actions. Also auto-generates default actions based on the kind and prompt ID.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines the normalized risk level based on provided risk or defaults from priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the normalized priority based on provided priority or defaults from risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns nil if the result is empty.
